overview.summary: Align DartClaw workflows, runtime fixtures and documentation with AndThen 1.0 rc.4, then qualify the renamed pipelines against the installed plugin.

sharedDecisions.title: One-story workflow identity
sharedDecisions.description: The built-in and inline names are story-and-implement and story-and-implement-inline; the helper becomes story.sh. Preserve the spec step ID, spec_path/spec_source outputs and dartclaw-discover-andthen-spec name. No old-name alias. S01 owns workflow-package non-document assets, skill payloads and tests, CLI code/tests, custom YAMLs and shell runners; S02 owns runtime code/tests; S03 owns remaining Markdown docs, prose scenario files and the historical visual session fixture. Canonical authoring stays in private; implementation runs in the public checkout after the existing bundle export projects structured paths.

sharedDecisions.title: Implementation scan surface
sharedDecisions.description: ASSUMPTION: The retired-term sweep covers shipped assets, tests, fixtures and permanent documentation, excluding CHANGELOG.md history, dev/adrs and temporary dev/bundle planning records. The existing release lifecycle removes the temporary bundle before shipping. Change this if acceptance must include working specifications before cleanup.

stories.name: Workflow rc4 alignment
stories.scope: Deliver C1-C4, workflow-side C7, C13 and C14: rename the one-story pipeline through workflow/CLI contracts and runners, remove custom council stages, use the inline-only execution flag, and correct discover-plan resume prose. Enforce Done when's nonempty producing-spec path through the existing generic output/schema authority while preserving detection's temporary empty value, output names and configured failure policies. Assign runtime surfaces to S02 and remaining documentation to S03.

stories.name: Runtime rc4 alignment
stories.scope: Deliver C12 and runtime-side C1: runtime integration stubs expose only shipped skills without duplicates, and runtime composition, API/UI test fixtures and displayed workflow names consume the new one-story identity. Keep runtime skill resolution and provisioning mechanisms unchanged.
stories.sequencing: Runtime fixtures consume the workflow registry identity delivered by S01.

stories.name: Documentation and live qualification
stories.scope: Deliver C5-C11 and remaining C1/C7 documentation: document the one-plugin prerequisite and simplify pass, correct process/status terminology, publish the 0.27.2 changelog entry and complete the source's retired-term sweep. Qualify the assembled change with the source's three real-provider workflow runs and record the implement-step duration. Update literal guards/fixtures without losing their original test intent; preserve the source's four explicit non-goals and record any external prerequisite failure honestly.
stories.sequencing: The documentation and live runs consume the final workflow contracts and runtime fixture alignment from S01 and S02.
